Specification: This module specifies a very small counter-style system with a single variable x. The system starts in state x = 1 and the only next-state action increments x by 1 on each step, with the behavior constrained by the temporal specification Init /\ [][Next]_vars. The file also defines a state constraint requiring x < 5, an AtMostOnce temporal property expressing that once x exceeds 2 it remains so after x has become greater than 1, a concrete postcondition about a generated counterexample trace using TLC extension operators, and a trivial leads-to property over vars.
